contents.name: Host
contents.description: The IP address or hostname of the Modbus TCP device or gateway (e.g. "10.0.0.5").

contents.name: Port
contents.description: The Modbus TCP port of the device (e.g. 502, the IANA-registered Modbus default).

contents.name: UnitIdentifier
contents.description: The Modbus unit identifier (0-255) routed in the MBAP header (e.g. 255). Conventionally 255 or 0 when addressing a Modbus TCP device directly; identifies one downstream slave (1-247) when connecting through a TCP-to-serial gateway.

contents.name: WordOrder

enumValues.name: HighWordFirst
enumValues.comment: The register at the lower address holds the most-significant 16 bits.

enumValues.name: LowWordFirst
enumValues.comment: The register at the lower address holds the least-significant 16 bits.

contents.description: The vendor-specific register order used to combine multiple consecutive 16-bit registers into 32-/64-bit values (e.g. "HighWordFirst"). The Modbus specification fixes byte order within one register but not word order across registers - this must match the target device's convention.

contents.name: DefaultReadCycleInterval
contents.description: Default poll interval in seconds (e.g. 10) for streams that do not set their own ReadCycleInterval.

contents.name: WriteCycleInterval
contents.description: The Modbus write cycle interval in seconds (e.g. 10) for cyclically writing configured Parameter values to the device.

contents.name: Streams
contents.description: Contains all Modbus streams of the given source.

contents.name: Parameter
contents.description: For writing configuration values to the Modbus device.

request.name: WriteOnceCommandRequest
request.description: Request for writing a value once to the Modbus device

fields.name: Datatype

enumValues.name: BOOL
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.Boolean. Valid only with Coil addresses (1 bit).

enumValues.name: INT32
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.Int32. 2 consecutive registers, combined per the source's WordOrder.

enumValues.name: UINT32
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.UInt32. 2 consecutive registers, combined per the source's WordOrder.

enumValues.name: FLOAT32
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.Single (IEEE 754). 2 consecutive registers, combined per the source's WordOrder.

enumValues.name: FLOAT64
enumValues.comment: .NET Type: System.Double (IEEE 754). 4 consecutive registers, combined per the source's WordOrder.

fields.description: Optional wire-type of the value to write (e.g. "FLOAT32"), token-identical to the Modbus parameter's Datatype enum. When omitted, the type falls back to the register kind the Identifier names: Coil - BOOL, HoldingRegister - one 16-bit register; multi-register values (INT32/UINT32/FLOAT32/FLOAT64) therefore require this field. BOOL is valid only with Coil addresses, the numeric types only with HoldingRegister addresses (1, 2 or 4 consecutive registers, combined per the source's WordOrder).

contents.name: Health
contents.description: Health message with Modbus source specific health information.
